versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "task-decomposer" skill.
- Automatically breaks down complex user requests into executable subtasks.
- Identifies required capabilities for each subtask using a universal capability taxonomy.
- Searches for existing skills on skills.sh and maps them to tasks.
- Creates new skills when no suitable solution is found in the skills ecosystem.
- Provides a clear execution plan to automate workflows or manage large tasks.
